note: Hand-curated baseline snapshot for the site launch (issue #100). Unlike data/metrics.json, this is not refreshed by an automated pipeline — update it manually when a signal is re-measured, recording the new snapshot date. The ROADMAP.md launch-metrics table is generated FROM this file: run `npm run sync:launch-metrics-table` after any edit here, and `npm run validate:launch-metrics` fails if the two drift out of sync.
inboundLinkMeasurementProcedure: GitHub code search for the canonical repo URL restricted to the cncf.io/contribute.cncf.io properties' source repos: `gh search code "cncf/endusers" --owner cncf --repo cncf/foundation --repo cncf/contribute.cncf.io`. Re-run the identical query at the 90-day mark and record the resulting count as the new value; this keeps the measurement reproducible instead of an ad hoc manual search.
